Summary of the websites shared in #general:
• www.informations.com: A brief jobs-report update notes that unemployment edged down to 7.2%, bringing a mix of relief and concern.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com: Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired Swiss restaurant in the city center. Its menu features cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue, with rustic wooden interiors, panoramic skyline views, and staff in traditional Swiss attire.

Hi Dora! I visited www.dora-website.com. The content clearly introduces it as your personal website and makes your contact email easy to find. It feels quite minimal, though; adding a short bio, your interests or projects, and a clearer description of what visitors can explore would make it more engaging. My feedback is based on the text I could access, rather than the visual design.

Hi Eve! I visited www.eve-blog.com. Mentioning your love of hiking gives the blog a friendly, personal starting point. The accessible content is quite brief; adding hiking stories, favorite trails, photos, or practical tips would give readers more to explore and a reason to return. My feedback is based on the text I could access, rather than the visual design.
